findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "api_discover" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Find API docs, developer portal, candidate base URLs and auth docs. Price: $0.004 USDC per successful call." → after: "Discover the callable public API behind a developer or documentation page: identify candidate API base URLs, developer portals, machine-readable API docs and authentication documentation for integration setup. Price: $0.004 USDC per successful call."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
